name: comp-317
title: Sticky Header Dialog
blurb: Example FAQ dialog with sticky header while content scrolls below.
description: A premade dialog template demonstrating how to keep the title/header fixed at the top while content scrolls independently.
use_when: Building dialogs where the title should remain visible while viewing long scrollable content.
avoid_when: When header scrolling is acceptable — this requires custom layout.
a11y: Uses Dialog primitives with proper semantic structure.
